description: Source-linked planning duration profiles. Dates are estimates for the named variety or stated source scope; they are not a district-specific package of practices.

varieties.name: Pearl millet (Bajra)
varieties.source: ICAR-IARI reports pearl millet cultivar maturity from 74–80 days for Pusa 605, 75–78 for Pusa 415, and 80–85 for Pusa Composite 612; 80 days is a representative planning value.

crops.source: ICAR Annual Report 2023–24 lists source-reported millet variety maturity values for finger, little, kodo, barnyard, proso, foxtail and brown-top millets. A type-specific selection is required because millet species have different durations.
crops.scope: Planning profile only. Select the millet type/variety before generating. Source-reported duration is not a district suitability or sowing-window recommendation; confirm locally.

crops.source: ICAR-IIWBR/KVK Gorakhpur: Karan Vandana flowers at 77 days and matures at 120 days after sowing.
crops.scope: Karan Vandana example from Gorakhpur; confirm variety and local sowing window.

crops.source: FAO Irrigation Water Management training manual Table 6 gives 120–150 days for Barley/Oats/Wheat; 135 days is the midpoint planning estimate.
crops.scope: Grouped FAO duration reference, not barley-cultivar-specific. Confirm local variety and sowing window with KVK or the state agricultural university.

crops.source: ICAR variety descriptions report Pusa Basmati 1509 at 115 days, Pusa Basmati 1121 at 135 days, and Jaya at 130 days.
crops.scope: Variety duration varies; transplanting method and nursery period affect field dates.

crops.source: ICAR Kharif Agro-Advisory 2025 gives 85–110 days for named short-to-medium duration maize varieties.
crops.scope: Range is variety-specific and not a state-wide sowing recommendation.

crops.source: ICAR reports Pusa Double Zero Mustard 31 at 142 days; ICAR reports NRCHB 101 at 105–110 days.
crops.scope: Named varieties differ materially in duration and recommended geography.

crops.source: ICAR Rabi Agro-Advisory lists named potato varieties with maturity ranges from 70–100 days.
crops.scope: Variety and temperature affect maturity; local advisory takes precedence.

crops.source: ICAR Kharif Agro-Advisory 2025 describes a 12–15 month crop duration.
crops.scope: Typical value is a planning midpoint of a 12–15 month range; do not use as a maturity diagnosis.

crops.source: ICAR-CICR variety table reports named cotton varieties maturing in 150–165 days; ICAR also reports short-duration Surabhi at 135 days.
crops.scope: Varieties and picking period vary by zone; use local package-of-practices dates.

crops.source: ICAR reports first picking of Arka Abhed at about 70 days after transplanting and harvesting for approximately 105 days.
crops.scope: This estimate is anchored to transplanting, not nursery sowing; repeat picking depends on conditions.

crops.source: ICAR reports maturity of Pusa Chickpea 10216 at 106 days and Pusa JG 16 at 110 days.
crops.scope: Variety examples are not a district suitability claim.

crops.source: ICAR reports NRC 127 at 104 days and NRC 142 at 96–97 days.
crops.scope: The cited variety profile notes recommendation regions; verify local suitability.

lifecycleRules.basis: DAS values for non-treatment monitoring checkpoints are calculated from the selected crop/variety duration profile. They are reminders to observe the field, not agronomic dose or treatment instructions. Verify timings against current state agricultural university or KVK guidance.

preSowing.name: Land preparation review
preSowing.description: Review local field-preparation guidance for the crop, soil and available machinery.
preSowing.recommendation: No tillage operation is prescribed by this reminder.

preSowing.name: Seed or planting material review
preSowing.description: Check that certified seed or planting material and locally approved guidance are available.
preSowing.recommendation: No chemical or dose is generated.

observationCheckpoints.name: Crop establishment check
observationCheckpoints.recommendation: Check emergence or transplant establishment and record gaps or stress.

observationCheckpoints.name: Weed monitoring check
observationCheckpoints.recommendation: Inspect for weeds; use locally approved integrated weed management guidance.

observationCheckpoints.name: Irrigation and soil-moisture review
observationCheckpoints.recommendation: Review root-zone moisture and use the Smart Irrigation Planner. No water dose is inferred from this date.

observationCheckpoints.name: Vegetative growth check
observationCheckpoints.recommendation: Record the observed crop stage and field condition.

observationCheckpoints.name: Pest and disease scouting
observationCheckpoints.recommendation: Scout and record symptoms; check local extension guidance before treatment.

observationCheckpoints.name: Irrigation and soil-moisture review
observationCheckpoints.recommendation: Check soil moisture and local conditions. No water dose is inferred from this date.

observationCheckpoints.name: Flowering-stage observation
observationCheckpoints.recommendation: Confirm the observed stage; flowering timing varies by variety and conditions.

observationCheckpoints.name: Pest and disease scouting
observationCheckpoints.recommendation: Inspect crop and seek local KVK advice for unusual pest or disease pressure.

observationCheckpoints.name: Grain, tuber or fruit development check
observationCheckpoints.recommendation: Observe crop development and keep a field note.

observationCheckpoints.name: Irrigation and soil-moisture review
observationCheckpoints.recommendation: Check crop stage and root-zone moisture before irrigation. No dose is inferred from this date.

observationCheckpoints.name: Estimated maturity check
observationCheckpoints.recommendation: Confirm maturity using crop indicators and local guidance; an estimated date alone is not a harvest signal.

observationCheckpoints.name: Harvest preparation and maturity review
observationCheckpoints.recommendation: Confirm maturity, weather and local harvest guidance before harvesting.
